name: Soyuz-22
about: Soyuz-22 (1976-093A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TM), launched 1976 Sep 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1976 Sep 18), held fixed
